lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yào mǎi yào.
lines.en: Hello, I want to buy some medicine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bìng le, shēntǐ hěn lèi.
lines.en: I'm sick and my body feels very tired.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Zhège yào yìtiān chī liǎng cì.
lines.en: Take this medicine twice a day.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thank you, and drink more water!
